question: What auspicious resolve is wished for the mind identified with the one light of lights?
premises: There is one light among lights
The mind is the subject of resolve
inference: May my mind, that one light of lights, have an auspicious resolve
uncertainties: apposition between tan me manaḥ and jyotir ekaṃ is interpretive
plain_english: That one light of lights, my mind, may it have an auspicious resolve.
